The exit-stack cleanup for dependencies that use `yield` is handled by `AsyncExitStackMiddleware`, defined in `fastapi/middleware/asyncexitstack.py`.

In its `__call__` method, this middleware creates an `AsyncExitStack`, stores it on `request.scope["fastapi_astack"]` (the key used by `solve_dependencies` in `fastapi/dependencies/utils.py` to register the yield-dependency context managers), and wraps the call to the next component in an `async with astack:` block. When the response has been sent and the `async with` block exits, the stack automatically calls `__aexit__` on all the yield-dependencies that were pushed onto it, running their "after yield" cleanup code (including handling exceptions raised in the endpoint).

This middleware is registered in `fastapi/applications.py`, in `FastAPI.build_middleware_stack()`, where it is added as the innermost middleware (wrapping the router) so that it runs for every request and ensures dependency cleanup always occurs.
